description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Andrew Vorhees (foot) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Vorhees has been sidelined for two-straight practices due to a foot issue, but he was back at practice on Wednesday and seems to be trending towards playing in Week 7. His return would be good news for Baltimore's offensive front ahead of a matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.title: Andrew Vorhees (foot) limited participant Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited by a groin issue on Wednesday. He has been able to play this issue recently, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to miss any time unless he suffers a setback with his recovery at some point.
items.title: John Simpson (groin) limited Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Cam Jurgens (concussion) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: It looks like Jurgens is nearing full health again, which means that he is likely to make his debut as a member of the Ravens this week. His anticipated presence will offer a nice boost to Baltimore's offensive front moving forward.
items.title: Cam Jurgens (concussion) logs full practice Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Stanley practiced as a limited participant on Wednesday. He is listed with all of the same issues that he was last week, however, and he was able to play through them in Week 6. The expectation is that he will do the same again on Sunday.
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) limited Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bateman is dealing with a shoulder issue right now. The exact severity of it is unknown, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, so it appears to be more of a short-term issue. Rookie Ja'Kobi Lane will see more work in Week 7 if the veteran is unable to suit up.
items.title: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (ankle) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jackson was able to make his return to practice on Wednesday and participated in a limited fashion. That's a big step in the right direction for his Week 7 availability, but the team isn't likely to make an official decision about his status until he has a couple more practices under his belt. Tyler Huntley will remain the starter for another week if Jackson still has to miss more time.
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially limited at practice Wednesday
